column2: (1)  The  Agency  may  make  rules  for  following
setting  out  the  procedure  for  adopting  testing
methods, establishment of Registered Testing Pools,
sample  collection,  accreditation  of  testing
laboratories, standards to be maintained by testing
laboratories  based  on  the  Code  of  International
Standards for testing Laboratories;
procedure to be followed in the analysis of samples;
procedure  for  results  management  in  relation  to
samples;
specifying  anti-doping  rules  applicable  and  the
consequences  of  anti-doping  rule  violation;
specifying  anti-doping  control  activities;
specifying the procedures applicable in relation to
Negative  Analytical  findings  and  Adverse
Analytical  findings  and  principles  governing
provisional suspension of an athlete, suspension of
an  athlete;
specifying matters connected with the granting of
TUE;
specifying the Sri Lanka Code of Standards for the

testing  of  samples  based  on 
the  Code  of
International Standards for testing of samples;
procedure for re-entry of a banned athlete;
procedure for the providing access to Independent
Observers;
the procedure to be followed by Agency in relation
to in competition testing of athletes; and
